questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Bulk modulus B=−ΔP/(ΔV/V)। compression fraction=ΔP/B=2×10⁶/((4)×10⁹)=1/(500×(4))।

questions.question_bn: A t=0-এ constant 4 m/s-এ যায়। একই origin থেকে B rest-এ, acceleration 2 m/s², delay 6 s পরে শুরু। B start-এর τ পরে catch হলে কোন equation?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। B-এর distance ½·2τ²=τ²। A-এর elapsed time τ+(6), distance 4(τ+(6)); origins same।

questions.question_bn: Rest energy mc²=10 J। total relativistic energy 2mc² হলে kinetic energy কত J?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Total E=K+mc²। K=2mc²−mc²=mc²=nJ; total ও kinetic energy আলাদা।

questions.question_bn: Mass m at speed 6 m/s stationary identical mass-এর সঙ্গে perfectly in elastic collision করে। final/initial total kinetic energy ratio কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। Momentum থেকে common v=u/2। final K=½·2m(u/2)²=mu²/4; initial mu²/2; ratio ½।

questions.question_bn: Twoidenticalcellsε=3 V,r2ΩparallelwithloadR 1Ω। load current কত A?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। Parallelcellsεsame,r_eq=r/2=1Ω। total Rload+r_eq=2Ω,I=(3)/2A; emf not double।

questions.question_bn: Force-time graph triangular: base 8 s, peak 6 N। particle mass 3 kg। speed change magnitude কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। Impulse triangle area=½·(8)·6=3×(8) N·s। Δv=J/m=3×(8)/3=(8)।

questions.question_bn: Two equal coherent sources each intensity 3। phase difference 90°। resultant intensity কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। I=I₁+I₂+2√(I₁I₂)cosφ। cos90°=0⇒2×(3); equal amplitudes হলেও constructive নয়।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Springs k₁=6, k₂=12 N/m series-এ mass m। effective k কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। Series 1/keff=1/k₁+1/k₂=3/(2×(6))⇒keff=2×(6)/3; parallel sum নয়।

questions.question_bn: a=(5,4,0) এবং unit b=(3/5,4/5,0)। b-direction-এ a-এর scalar projection কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। Scalar projection a·b̂=(5)×(3/5)+4(4/5)=(3×(5)+16)/5; b ইতিমধ্যে unit।

questions.question_bn: Particle charge 4 C uniform static B-এ moves, electric field নেই। magnetic force-এর কাজ কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Magnetic force qv×B always perpendicular to velocity। P=F·v=0; speed/kinetic energy অপরিবর্তিত।

questions.question_bn: A⇌B-এর K=5। 2B⇌2A-এর equilibrium constant কত?

questions.question_bn: Two equal bond dipoles μ=6D make 120°। net dipole কত D?

questions.question_bn: Gas mixture 6 mol N₂,2 mol O₂; total pressure 3atm। O₂ partial pressure কত?

questions.question_bn: Wet food 20 kg moisture 40%w/w। সব water remove, dry solid unchanged। dry mass কত kg?

questions.question_bn: 18molnon-electrolyte 500gwater-এ dissolve। molality কত mol/kg?

questions.question_bn: MX₂(s)⇌M²⁺+2X⁻। pure-water molar solubility s=21×10⁻⁴M। Ksp কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 21। Ion concentrations s,2s। Ksp=s(2s)²=4s³=4×(21)³×10⁻¹²; stoichiometric coefficient squared।

questions.question_bn: Food oil iodometry-তে I₂ 11mmol মুক্ত। I₂+2S₂O₃²⁻→2I⁻+S₄O₆²⁻। thiosulfate কত mmol?

questions.question_bn: 12 mol simple mono aldehyde (formaldehyde নয়) excess Tollens reagent reduces। Ag produced কত mol?

questions.question_bn: Diluted water initial DO8mg/L, after 5days 6mg/L; sample fraction 1/5, blank correction 0। BOD₅ কত mg/L?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। DO depletion=2mg/L in diluted mixture। Original sample BOD=(DOinitial−DOfinal)/fraction=2nmg/L।

questions.question_bn: 2H₂+O₂→2H₂O। H₂=54 mol,O₂=18 mol। remainingH₂ কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 18। O₂limitingn moluses 2nH₂। initial 3×(18) minusconsumed 2×(18) leavesn mol; product 2×(18) আলাদা।

questions.question_bn: AcidicKMnO₄ 11mmol fullyoxidises Fe²⁺→Fe³⁺। Fe²⁺amount কত mmol?

questions.question_bn: Ag Cl Ksp=1×10⁻¹⁰। Na Cl solution [Cl⁻]=12×10⁻²M, Ag Cl saturated; s≪[Cl⁻]। [Ag⁺] কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 12। Ksp=[Ag⁺][Cl⁻]। common-ion approximation s=10⁻¹⁰/((12)×10⁻²)=(1/(12))×10⁻⁸M।

questions.question_bn: Ozone decomposition 2O₃→3O₂। 22 mol ozone fully decomposes। total gas mole increase কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 22। FinalO₂=(3/2)(22)। initial gas (22), increase=(3/2)(22)−(22)=(22)/2; final mole ও increment আলাদা।

questions.question_bn: κ=18×10⁻³S/cm,C=0.10 mol/L। Λm কত S·cm²/mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 18। Λm=1000κ/C withcM,κS/cm。1000·(18)10⁻³/0.10=10×(18); L→cm³factor 1000。
